name: XCL World Academy
summary: IB programmes with modern facilities on a Yio Chu Kang campus.
body: XCL World Academy offers IB education with contemporary campus facilities in the north-east. Families comparing mid-to-premium IB options often include XCL alongside longer-established names. Transport and bus routes should be part of the decision, not an afterthought.
waitlistNotes: Newer relative to legacy schools — ask about cohort sizes by grade.
